body:
## Bug
On the Strategy page, a planning run's `strategy decision` proposal is always refused, and only the command's usage line comes back. D-254 point 3 says a strategy run proposes decisions this way. Decisions proposed from board tasks (`task decision`) still work.

**Expected:** `strategy decision` with an entry in `text` (`## <title>`, what was decided, `Why:`) is shown to the human as a proposal. It is appended to `DECISIONS.md` when approved, and `## D-<n> <title>` edits that record (D-255).

## Where it fails (for the agent)
The command dispatcher for strategy runs, `board::strategy.strategy_command`, matches only `task | feature | milestone | vision`, so `decision` falls through to the usage error. Its own usage text lists `strategy decision`. The proposal path below it, `tasks::proposal`, already handles `"decision"`, and the tests in `tasks.tests` (`a_strategy_decision_proposal_appends_on_approval` and others) call that function directly, which is why they never caught the gap. `help strategy` also leaves `strategy decision` out.

Done when: a strategy run's `strategy decision` call reaches the human as a proposal, approving it appends or edits the record, a test goes through `strategy_command` and fails on the old code, and `help strategy` lists the command.
title: strategy: decision proposals refused
